name: sparkline
title: Sparkline
description: A tiny line chart with no axes for rows, cards and tables. Plain SVG, optional area and end dot, with a spoken summary of the range.

props.name: data
props.description: The values to plot, oldest first.

props.name: tone
props.description: Color of the line, from the theme tokens.

props.name: area
props.description: Fill the area under the line with a soft tint.

props.name: dot
props.description: Mark the last value with a dot.

props.name: smooth
props.description: Curve the line between points instead of using straight segments.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for the line to draw in.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. A summary of the range is added after it.
